annotations.title: Read a company's record on the Trooth Network

description: Read one company's published record on the Trooth Network, given its domain or Trooth slug. The identifier is matched exactly (a URL is reduced to its host), never by a similar name. Returns a status (published, listed, private, unclaimed or unavailable) and a provenance label; text the company wrote about itself is labeled as its own words. Read only.

company.description: Company domain (e.g. acme.com) or Trooth slug

name: trooth_public_trust_profile

outputSchema.description: The typed form of every answer a tool completes. A call that fails partway answers isError: true with text only and no structured record.

claim_url.description: Present when the subject has no published record (unclaimed or private).

provenance.description: Where this answer came from. An honest_absence is missing data, never a judgment about the subject. A read_failed means Trooth could not read its own record at this moment and asserts nothing either way; retry rather than concluding.

subject.description: The company, domain or token this answer is about.

summary.description: The same answer as the text content, for display.
